definitions.domestic_realisasi: Kementerian ESDM investment realization is a sectoral statistical series. Do not sum it with BKPM PMA+PMDN as they may have different methodologies, perimeter and overlap.
definitions.investment_flow: Capital expenditure or investment realization over a time period.
definitions.committed: Proposed/signed funding may be subject to milestones and closing; does not establish cash actually paid or capital goods created.
definitions.outbound: Capital deployed or proposed by an Indonesia-linked vehicle abroad. This is NOT Indonesian domestic investment realization.
definitions.assets_under_management: Stock of investment assets managed on behalf of clients; AUM is NOT annual new investment, nor shareholder purchase consideration.
definitions.currency: USD billions unless otherwise indicated. No FX conversion is performed.
definitions.receipt: Fiscal PNBP receipts are public revenue and cannot be combined with ESDM investment spending.

assessment: Indonesia's reported 2025 ESDM sector investment total was US$31.96bn; it is not directly additive to national BKPM PMA/PMDN statistics.
At US$18.02bn, oil and gas was the largest named ESDM investment segment in 2025, while minerba reached about US$7.00bn.
ESDM 2025 investment surpassed its US$29.47bn sector target, but oil-and-gas execution was below its own US$21.67bn sub-target.
Minerba licence-class investment is not an accurate proxy for exact nickel, copper or coal project spending without further licence-to-commodity mapping.
HighPeak is outward-bound portfolio exposure in US oil and gas; it cannot be portrayed as inbound Indonesian FDI or local oilfield capital formation.
DAM's AUM over Rp170tn represents a stock of assets under management, not incremental investment capital or a purchase price.
Monitor financed/paid, construction and commissioning milestones independently; preserve provenance, period and corporate reporting boundaries.
